answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused to reopen price and the contract hard-stops in 14 days, so renew, renegotiate, and defer either miss the 18% spend mandate or create a supply cliff. The low-cost quote is the only path that meets the cost objective; memory_c2 is the load-bearing (unverified) claim that a primary switch was quick and operationally clean. That claim may not transfer to a 94% loaded line with no buffer, so delivery/downstream production risk is flagged and c2 plus the incumbent-stability record (c1) should be pulled before treating the last switch as applicable. Dual-source is a separate decision and would not cover the expiring primary.
